name: Varun Beverages Ltd
title: Varun Beverages Ltd - 540180 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 CY26 volume +16.3% with India +14.4% and India realisation -1.5%, but management is buying growth via discounts and Rs 10 packs while capex falls to Rs 500-600 crore, so supply discipline is strong and pricing is soft.

triggers.label: India capex Rs 500-600 crore FY
triggers.quote: Our CAPEX will be less than Rs. 500 crore - Rs. 600 crore this year for India.

triggers.label: India realisation -1.5% YoY
triggers.quote: In India, realization per case declined by a marginal 1.5%, primarily due to volume growth initiatives

triggers.label: Six months raw material cover
triggers.quote: We normally carry 6 months inventory in international, our impact will be practically very low

triggers.label: Volume +16.3%, India +14.4%
triggers.quote: Consolidated sales volumes grew by 16.3% in Q1 CY2026 driven by volume growth of 14.4% in India

triggers.label: Discounts cut as input costs rise
triggers.quote: we are covering that by reducing our discounts and becoming more efficient

guidance.value: Growth to continue in double digits for next 5-10 years
guidance.quote: we believe the growth should continue in double-digits for the next 5-10 years at least

guidance.value: About half a million new outlets in CY26
guidance.quote: Hopefully this year we might expand half a million outlets.
Our CAPEX will be less than Rs. 500 crore - Rs. 600 crore this year for India.

red_flags.label: Rs 10 price-point push and pack upsizing diluting India realisation
red_flags.quote: selective price point launches in identified markets to on-board new consumers

red_flags.label: Capital allocation is management-led and overlays inflation via discounts
red_flags.quote: we are covering that by reducing our discounts and becoming more efficient
